lede: Vanderbilt carries the stronger underlying team rating — +6.8 against +4.3, a 2.5-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Auburn -2.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Auburn winning 55% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is scheme fit, where Vanderbilt leads Auburn by 121 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 88% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
